evidence.observation: Boot shows the menu card; the top bar reads BEST 0 on a fresh save folder.
evidence.riff: The best wave is the only thing the game remembers; a fresh save proves it starts from nothing.

evidence.observation: Clicking START enters play with 50 gold and 5 lives.
evidence.riff: Mouse and keyboard both start a run; the mouse path never touched the InputMap, which is how the dead-keyboard bug hid.

evidence.observation: Clicking the Fire button highlights it and enters build mode.
evidence.riff: The bar shows cost and a one-word skill, so the choice is legible before any tooltip.

evidence.observation: A ghost tower and its 2.5-tile range circle follow the cursor across the board.
evidence.riff: Range is visible before spending, which matters when every tower also reshapes the road.

evidence.observation: Clicking lava flashes the tile red with "Can't build here".
evidence.riff: Lava is walkable but not buildable; the tint warns before the click.

evidence.observation: Fire placed at (10,1); gold drops 50 to 30.
evidence.riff: The corner covers both legs of the default L-shaped route.

evidence.observation: Key 2 enters Ice build mode.
evidence.riff: Keys 1 to 4 mirror the bar; they arrived in the Phase B input audit.

evidence.observation: Right-click cancels build mode; the ghost disappears.
evidence.riff: A cheap undo before money is spent.

evidence.observation: Storm (35) with 5 gold is refused: "Not enough gold".
evidence.riff: Gold is checked first, so even a lava click reports gold when you are broke.

evidence.observation: Esc leaves build mode and does not pause.
evidence.riff: One key, two meanings, ordered: cancel first, pause second.

evidence.observation: Space releases wave 1; two monsters walk the tinted shortest route from IN to OUT.
evidence.riff: The route tint is the whole maze readout; whether it is strong enough is checklist item 1.

evidence.observation: Fire and Ice shoot automatically; by the end of wave 1 gold has gone from 5 to 13.
evidence.riff: Kill income is 4 gold flat; checklist item 14 asks whether that keeps a player building.

evidence.observation: The SPEED button goes 1x to 2x; F goes to 3x and later back to 1x.
evidence.riff: Speed multiplies the clock, not the rules, so outcomes should not change with speed.

evidence.observation: Two wave-2 monsters reach OUT; LIVES drops from 5 to 3.
evidence.riff: A leak is the only way to lose; on main it is shown only by the LIVES counter, which turns red at two or fewer. (AUDIO-PLAN.md mentions a red vignette; that exists only on the unmerged art branch.)

evidence.observation: At 0 lives: "The exit was overrun. Furthest wave: 3  Best: 3".
evidence.riff: Endless by decision: losing is the only end state.

evidence.observation: Enter on the game-over card starts a fresh run: 50 gold, 5 lives, wave 0.
evidence.riff: Retry is one key; the compounding ramp resets with it.

evidence.observation: Clicking a placed tower shows its range and SELL 10 / UPGRADE 30.
evidence.riff: Sell and upgrade live in one panel, priced before you commit.

evidence.observation: UPGRADE spends 30; a chevron appears; the button reads MAXED; SELL becomes 34.
evidence.riff: One tier only; sale value adds round(0.8 x 30).

evidence.observation: Right-click with a tower selected clears the selection.
evidence.riff: Same gesture as cancel, applied to the other mode.

evidence.observation: Enter on the menu starts a run.
evidence.riff: The keyboard path that was once dead now works on its own.

evidence.observation: Trying to build on a tile a monster occupies is refused: "Monster in the way".
evidence.riff: You cannot drop a tower on a monster to trap it.

evidence.observation: With Fire at (0,1), Fire at (1,0) would seal the spawn and is refused: "Would block the path".
evidence.riff: The rule the Unity original lacked; the reason is visible for at most 0.3 s.

evidence.observation: A tower placed on the road at (5,0) is accepted and the tinted route changes; wave 2 follows it.
evidence.riff: This is the maze: building changes where they walk, not just what shoots them.

evidence.observation: Selecting the (0,1) tower and pressing SELL returns 10 gold.
evidence.riff: Selling reopens the tile and re-paths everyone.

evidence.observation: F1 shows the debug overlay; only its left edge is visible, the rest is covered by the board.
evidence.riff: Defect: drawn by the session under its own Grid child.

evidence.observation: Esc mid-wave shows "Paused." and freezes the board; Enter resumes.
evidence.riff: The card lists R and Esc; Enter also resumes.

evidence.observation: A poisoned wave-2 monster turns pale white rather than green while the poison ticks.
evidence.riff: Each 0.1 s tick is a hit, and each hit resets the white flash; checklist item 10.

evidence.observation: The Storm beam hits one monster and hops to its neighbour, visible for 6 frames (0.2 s) at 1x.
evidence.riff: Shown again as a labelled 1/8-speed replay; checklist item 11.

evidence.observation: When macOS brings Finder forward, the game pauses; it stays paused when focus returns until Enter.
evidence.riff: Correct and conservative: regaining focus does not resume play.

evidence.observation: R mid-wave restarts: wave 0, 50 gold, board cleared.
evidence.riff: Restart resets the health ramp too (deviation D-05).

evidence.observation: A new process boots showing BEST 3, written by an earlier run.
evidence.riff: The one value saved to disk survives a relaunch.

evidence.observation: With walker/debug/enabled=true, F2 jumps from wave 1 to 2, then to 3.
evidence.riff: A playtest tool, off by default; this take enabled it on purpose.

evidence.observation: With level_01.json missing "exit", an error panel is drawn but the menu card covers most of it; Enter then sets PLAYING and Space starts wave 1 behind a frozen HUD.
evidence.riff: Staged in a copy. The failure surface exists, but a player cannot read it.

features.reason: AUDIO-PLAN.md specifies eight cues; the source had no audio and none has been added.
An unmerged branch wires recovered PNGs behind a default-off toggle; main ships no recovered art pending provenance review.

not_exercised: exported builds (all takes ran from source)
